predecessors.name: Western Turks after the Tang conquest (Cliopatria 'Turks')
predecessors.text: the Western Turkic tribes of the Chu valley and Zhetysu, whose leadership the Turgesh took over

predecessors.name: Tang dynasty
predecessors.text: Suyab, captured in 703 (one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi on the Western Turkic Khaganate page)

successors.name: Karluk Yabghu
successors.text: Zhetysu, which the Karluks conquered in 766 (Karluks page: 'formed a khanate under a Yabghu, occupied Suyab, and moved their capital there')

ledger.cpn: Western Turks after the Tang conquest (Cliopatria 'Turks')

ledger.x: 703: Wuzhile takes Suyab and the span from Chach to Turfan and Beshbaliq.
711: Tonyukuk beats the Turgesh at the Boluchu River in Dzungaria.
715: Qapaghan is assassinated and the Second Turkic push into Dzungaria ends.
719: the rulers of Transoxiana appeal to their Turgesh overlords.
721: Kül Chor beats the Umayyads near Samarkand.
732: the Umayyads recover Samarkand and Bukhara.
732: Caliphal authority returns to Sogdia and the Turgesh overlordship ends there.
736: the Tang, allied to the Umayyads since 735, beat Suluk at Beshbalik.
743: Nasr ibn Sayyar secures Transoxiana for the caliphate.
745: the Tang hold the lands beyond Zhetysu after executing Kül Chor.
766: the Karluks end the Turgesh Khaganate.

wars.name: Battle of Bolchu (Second Turkic-Turgesh war)
wars.outcome: Qapaghan and Tonyukuk beat the Turgesh and kill Saqal and Zhenu (711); the Turks fight near Samarkand in 713-714 and fail to take Beshbalik; Qapaghan is assassinated in 715.

wars.name: Tang-Turgesh wars of 708-717
wars.outcome: Saqal attacks Kucha (708) and beats a Tang force (709); Tang sends Ashina Xian (appointed 712); in 717 Xian leads Tang-allied Karluk forces, defeats the Turgesh and drives them out of the Tarim Basin.

wars.name: Battle of Aksu
wars.outcome: Tang victory: General Tang Jiahui defeated the Arab-Tibetan-Turgesh attack on Aksu and Uch Turfan on 15 August 717.

wars.name: Turgesh-Umayyad wars in Transoxiana
wars.outcome: Turgesh victories near Samarkand (721), the Day of Thirst (724), Bukhara (728) and the Defile (731); Arab recovery by 732; Suluk defeated at Kharistan in winter 737 and murdered in 738; Nasr recovered most of Transoxiana by 743.

wars.name: Tang-Umayyad campaign against Suluk
wars.outcome: The Tang ally with the Umayyads against Suluk (735); his forces are beaten at Beshbalik (736).

wars.name: Turgesh civil war and Tang suzerainty
wars.outcome: After Suluk's murder the Black (Kara) and Yellow (Sary) factions fight; Kül Chor of the Yellow beats Tumoche of the Black, submits to the Tang in 740, kills a Tang puppet in 742 and is captured and executed by the Tang in 744.

wars.name: Karluk conquest of Zhetysu
wars.outcome: The Karluks overrun the Turgesh in Zhetysu, occupy Suyab and end the khaganate.
